bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: The previous session ended unexpectedly and the secure storage cache is out of sync with the session keyring. Some applications may fail to access saved credentials until the cache is reconciled and stale locks are cleared. This action will verify integrity and rebuild the cache without modifying data.
